about.description: I'm Mohit — a freelance graphic designer who believes design should provoke, not just please. I specialize in brand identities, digital experiences, and visual systems that refuse to be ignored.

highlights.title: Pixel Perfect
highlights.text: Every detail obsessed over. Every pixel placed with intent.

highlights.title: Fast Turnaround
highlights.text: Quick iterations without cutting corners. Your deadline is my deadline.

highlights.title: Direct Communication
highlights.text: No middlemen. You work with me directly from brief to delivery.

services.title: Brand Identity
services.description: Logo design, color systems, typography selection, brand guidelines, and full visual identity packages that tell your story.

services.title: Video Editing
services.description: Professional video editing including cuts, transitions, color grading, sound design, and motion graphics. Polished and ready for publishing.

services.title: Print & Packaging
services.description: Posters, business cards, brochures, product packaging, and editorial layouts for physical media.

services.title: Illustration
services.description: Custom digital illustrations, icon sets, and visual assets for campaigns, products, and editorial use.

process.title: Discovery
process.text: We talk about your brand, goals, audience, and vision. I ask the hard questions upfront.

process.title: Concept
process.text: I explore multiple directions and present 2-3 strong concepts with mood boards and rationale.

process.title: Refine
process.text: We iterate on the chosen direction. Two rounds of revisions are included in every project.

process.title: Deliver
process.text: You receive production-ready files in all formats you need, plus a style guide for consistency.

contact.description: Got a project in mind? I'm currently taking on new clients. Let's create something that breaks the mold.
